chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Abu Muhammad al-Ghifari, from Abdullah ibn Ibrahim, from the one who narrated it, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
Rasool-Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The one who is tired of the power (authorities), so let him nourish the young (ones)'.
Muhammad ibn Isa has commented that Al-Ghifary is from the children of Abu Zarr (peace be upon him).

key_terms.أَعْيَتْهُ الْقُدْرَةُ: He was tired of the power/authority

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet say about dealing with limited power or authority?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, the Prophet Muhammad advises that when one's own capacity or authority feels insufficient or overwhelming, they should turn to nurturing the young, emphasizing the spiritual and social value of raising the next generation. The chain of narration highlights the connection between the Ghifar tribe and Abu Zarr al-Ghifari, a prominent companion known for his asceticism and loyalty, thereby linking the practice of nurturing youth to a legacy of righteous companionship.

en.hubeali:
Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abu Muhammad Al-Ghifary, from Abdullah Bin Ibrahim, from the one who narrated it, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who is tired of the power (authorities), so let him nourish the young (ones)’.
Muhammad Bin Isa has commented that Al-Ghifary is from the children of Abu Zarr<sup>as</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 31. Ahmad ibn Muhammad from has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from abu Muhammad al-Ghifariy from ‘Abd Allah ibn Ibrahim from those who narrated to him who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘
One who is tired of power must cherish small ones.’”
Muhammad ibn ‘Isa thinks that al-Ghifariy is of the children of abu Dharr, may Allah be pleased with him.
